items.title: Apollo chief economist warns the Fed may be overlooking diesel price risk
items.summary: Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Slok warns that record diesel prices may pose a far greater inflation threat than the Fed currently assesses, because diesel costs seep into the core CPI — the very gauge at the heart of Fed monetary policy.
items.title_zh: 阿波罗首席经济学家警告：美联储可能忽视了柴油价格风险
items.summary_zh: 阿波罗全球管理公司首席经济学家Torsten Slok发出警告，创纪录的柴油价格对通胀构成的威胁，可能远超美联储目前的评估——因为柴油成本会渗透进核心消费者价格指数，而后者恰恰是美联储货币政策的核心参照指标

items.title: Nearly a decade late, Tesla's Semi finally enters mass production

items.summary: CLS, September 26 wire: A federal jury in San Diego reportedly ruled that Apple must pay more than $5.7 billion in damages for infringing vibration-technology patents held by Taction Technology, patents used in several iPhone and Apple Watch products.
